paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.55 as of October 23, with a decrease of 3.77% from the prior close and 43.96% over 22 sessions.

There are 2 new news headlines in the last 24 hours, including one from Yahoo Finance about the CEO's plan to use project-level funding structures for Project Matador and another from MarketBeat about the stock falling 3.8% due to insider selling.

Recent filings include 4 Form 4 and 3 Form 144 filings, with the most recent Form 4 filing on October 22 and Form 144 filing on October 20, as well as a Form 8-K filing on October 16 regarding an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
